business_problem: Now, M&S has established BEAM, its cloud data platform and the home of its data tooling, the data itself and the new capabilities and solutions it is powering. BEAM is enabling new capabilities through data science and analytics solutions across the business to better serve customers and colleagues, and supporting M&S's efforts to democratize data for all
solution_summary: Now, M&S has established BEAM, its cloud data platform and the home of its data tooling, the data itself and the new capabilities and solutions it is powering. BEAM is enabling new capabilities through data science and analytics solutions across the business to better serve customers and colleagues, and supporting M&S's efforts to democratize data for all With technology and innovation at the heart of M&S's business, data has increasingly become key to improving customer and colleague experiences. Due to its scale, M&S deals with huge amounts of data. From supply chain logistics to retail shopping metrics, M&S aims to integrate relevant data into all decision-making across the business-and so opening up access to relevant At the beginning of its data journey, M&S had many disparate data homes across the organization and underwent a project to consolidate data into an on-premises data environment to support analytics across the organization.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Processes and transforms large datasets for analytics, modeling, and downstream reporting.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Factory
solution_components.role: Orchestrates and ingests data pipelines from operational source systems into the analytics platform.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Unifies large-scale SQL, lake, and analytics workloads for enterprise reporting and data engineering.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can monitor operations and act on live insights.

data_flow: Operational data is ingested through Azure Data Factory processed in Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics and published to teams through Power BI dashboards.
